text: BAM share rose 0.09 percentage points over 25 hours and 1.51 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.3%. Concentration remains elevated: the largest node holds 22.2% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 63 top-node leadership changes in this window reflect whale-driven routing, while the validated structural-rollover record remains limited to the fra event with 22 minutes of lead time.
